visualCharacteristics.purpose: product page shell: product title, a tab strip (Overview, Product highlights, Product comparison) and the product hero beneath it

contentPattern.structure: optional first row: product title heading (single cell). Then one row per tab: label (may include an icon; a link with no panel makes a link tab to a sub-page) | panel content. A panel holding one picture plus heading and text renders as a photo with an inset text box. A panel holding only a bare page URL loads that page as a fragment

reuseGuidance: Use at the top of product detail pages. If the tabs link to sub-pages, author each tab label as a link and leave the panel empty. For in-page tabbed content use tabs-section.
decisions: Tabs that are links to sub-pages render as link tabs; the current page's tab is marked aria-current.
